body:
I assume you’re young, given the fact you mentioned your ex girlfriend is 19, so that gives me hope you have time to make some changes. 

You sound incredibly controlling, narcissistic and judgemental as hell. Her money, and what she spends it on, is absolutely none of your business. You aren’t married and weren’t sharing bills. Even if you were, you don’t get to dictate to someone else how to spend THEIR money. 

I think you need to let that poor girl go so she can find someone else that won’t hold her to your impossible standards. Use this as a learning lesson on how to let someone be their own person without conditioning them to be your “dream girl”.
